chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from 'Ubay ibn Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'What do you say regarding a man who marries a woman, and her father gifts to her a slave girl whom he had copulated with? Is it permissible for her husband to copulate with her?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to have relations with a slave girl gifted to his wife by her father?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the principle of 'isti'bra'' (waiting period) and exclusivity in marital relations, confirming that a husband's right to his wife extends to her concubines regardless of the father-in-law's prior sexual access. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the father's prior intercourse does not create a barrier (haram) for the son-in-law, emphasizing the distinct legal status of the wife's property and concubines within the household structure.
